explanation: The fundamental solutions cos(2x) and sin(2x) have Wronskian 2. Variation of parameters gives u1=-x+(1/2)sin(2x) and u2=ln|cos(x)|-(1/2)cos(2x)-1/2. Thus yp=-x cos(2x)+sin(2x)ln|cos(x)|-(1/2)sin(2x). Absorbing the last homogeneous term into B gives option e, valid on intervals where cos(x)≠0.
